text:
This looks like a post-meal photo. The plate holds a banana peel and a few scraps of scrambled egg, and the bowl, glass and mug are essentially empty. The only edible food left is a few crumbs of egg, about 10 g, at roughly 1.5 kcal/g, which is about 15 kcal. I'm excluding the banana peel because it isn't normally eaten. A faint residue in the glass and bowl adds a few more kcal, so I'm rounding up slightly.
